map.根据腹泻次数、大便性状及脱水体征，评估脱水程度并给出补液方案: Grade dehydration by stool frequency, stool character and dehydration signs, and give a rehydration plan
map.提示：急性腹泻多由病毒(轮状/诺如)引起，多为自限性。血便需排查细菌性肠炎(志贺: Note: acute diarrhea is mostly viral (rotavirus/norovirus) and self-limiting. Bloody stool needs workup for bacterial enteritis (Shigella/Salmonella/EHEC). Rice-water stool needs cholera workup. Zinc shortens illness (10-20 mg/day ×10-14 days). Low-osmolarity ORS III is the first-choice oral rehydration salt. Antibiotics are not routine; used only for bloody stool/severe bacterial infection. This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.维持量=1000 mL/日(前 10kg×100)；中重度按缺失补累计量。: Maintenance = 1000 mL/day (first 10 kg × 100); moderate-severe add cumulative deficit.
map.血便提示细菌性肠炎，需培养；EHEC 慎用抗生素以防 HUS。: Bloody stool suggests bacterial enteritis, needs culture; avoid antibiotics in EHEC to prevent HUS.
map.前 10kg×100、10–20kg 部分×50、>20kg 部分×20 mL/: First 10 kg ×100, 10-20 kg portion ×50, >20 kg portion ×20 mL/day.
map.米泔水样便按甲类管理，大量快速口服/静脉补液。: Rice-water stool is managed as class-A; massive rapid oral/IV rehydration.
map.儿童腹泻(脱水程度)分度器，根据腹泻次数、性状及脱水体征评估脱水程度与补液方案。: The pediatric diarrhea (dehydration severity) grader assesses dehydration degree and rehydration plan from stool frequency, character and signs. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.如何使用腹泻(脱水程度)分度器: How to use the Diarrhea (Dehydration Severity) Grader
map.腹泻(脱水程度)分度器是做什么的？: What does the Diarrhea (Dehydration Severity) Grader do?
map.输入儿童腹泻次数、大便性状及眼窝凹陷、口渴、皮肤弹性等脱水体征，评估轻/中/重度: Enter the child's stool frequency, stool character and dehydration signs (sunken eyes, thirst, skin turgor) to assess mild/moderate/severe dehydration and suggest oral or IV rehydration. For home and clinic pediatric diarrhea assessment.
map.如何使用腹泻(脱水程度)分度器？: How to use the Diarrhea (Dehydration Severity) Grader?
map.腹泻(脱水程度)分度器适合哪些场景？: Which scenarios is the Diarrhea (Dehydration Severity) Grader suitable for?
map.脱水程度按体征计数：重度(≥2项重度体征，或≥1重+≥2中) 失体液10%、中度: Dehydration grading by sign count: severe (≥2 severe signs, or ≥1 severe + ≥2 moderate) 10% fluid deficit, moderate (≥2 moderate, or ≥1 moderate + ≥2 mild) 7.5%, mild 4%, none 0%. Cumulative deficit (mL) = weight (kg) × deficit% × 1000. Daily maintenance: <10 kg 100 mL/kg, 10–20 kg 1000+(weight−10)×50, >20 kg 1500+(weight−20)×20. WHO 2005 rehydration: Plan A ORS after each loose stool (<2 y 50–100 mL, ≥2 y 100–200 mL); Plan B ORS 75 mL/kg over 4 h; Plan C IV 100 mL/kg (<12 mo 30 mL/kg in 1 h + 70 mL/kg over 5 h). Zinc: 10 mg/day <6 mo, 20 mg/day ≥6 mo for 10–14 days.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：weight×deficit×1000；维持量 10: Key formulas: weight×deficit×1000; maintenance by the 100-50-20 rule
map.请输入有效年龄（0–60 月）、体重（0.5–100 kg）、腹泻次数（1–30: Enter valid age (0–60 months), weight (0.5–100 kg), stool frequency (1–30/day) and duration (0–30 days); blank or out-of-range values are not interpreted.
map.Plan A：每次稀便后补充 ORS，<2 岁 50–100 mL/次、≥2 岁: Plan A: ORS after each loose stool, 50–100 mL (<2 y) or 100–200 mL (≥2 y)
map.继续母乳/饮食喂养，不禁食: Continue breastfeeding/normal feeding; do not fast
map.Plan B：ORSIII 75 mL/kg，4 小时内少量多次；4 小时后复评: Plan B: ORS 75 mL/kg over 4 h in small frequent amounts; reassess at 4 h
map.Plan B：ORSIII 75 mL/kg，4 小时内；若持续呕吐/口服失败或: Plan B: ORS 75 mL/kg over 4 h; if persistent vomiting/oral failure or still moderate at 4 h → switch to IV fluids
map.Plan C：静脉补液 100 mL/kg，3–6 小时；<12 月：30 mL: Plan C: IV fluids 100 mL/kg over 3–6 h; <12 mo: 30 mL/kg over 1 h + 70 mL/kg over 5 h; ≥12 mo: 30 mL/kg over 30 min + 70 mL/kg over 2.5 h
map.如伴休克，先以 20 mL/kg 等渗盐水/林格液快速复苏并复评: If shocked, give 20 mL/kg isotonic saline/Ringer solution rapidly and reassess
map.监测：血压、尿量、电解质、意识: Monitor: blood pressure, urine output, electrolytes, consciousness
map.见尿补钾: Add potassium after urine output is established
map.本页按体征计数简化分度；WHO IMCI 以精神状态、眼窝、口渴、皮肤回缩四项体: This page uses a simplified sign count; WHO IMCI uses four signs (mental status, sunken eyes, thirst, skin pinch). Results are rehydration estimates only; severe or worsening cases need emergency care.
